verdict.rationale: Codegen documents a Slack App for talking to the agent directly in your workspace. In Slack channels the agent can ask for clarification, report progress and interact with the team, and it can be delegated bug fixes and tasks. A behavior setting has the agent respond only to comments that explicitly mention it, which supports the tag-to-invoke pattern. missing for 10: explicit documentation of @-mentioning the agent inside a chat thread (the mention setting appears to cover comments rather than Slack threads specifically), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Slack thread workflow.
